name: Sharps Ridge
summary: Knox County, TN fire tower at the top of Sharp's Ridge in Knoxville's memorial park; listed as standing, but builder and build date were not found and the sources disagree on elevation.
agency: City of Knoxville (park land); tower owner not documented

access.note: The tower stands inside a public city park, but no source says the old fire tower is open to visitors or to climbers

visit.trail_note: Sharp's Ridge Memorial Park is accessible from Broadway, off Ludlow Street; a 2023 news report said park trails would stay open during tower work

events.note: City moving to buy the ridge as a war-memorial park; fundraisers planned a memorial at the highest peak with an observation tower (the source does not say the tower was built)
First automobile road to the top completed in October, mainly to serve the war-memorial project
WROL and WTSK went on air; first East Tennessee TV signals came from broadcast towers on the ridge (not the fire tower)
Contractor began taking down a 701-foot WBIR backup broadcast tower beside the J.B. Owen Overlook; overlook closed for parts of June to August (broadcast tower, not the fire tower)
